test.message: Can I claim my spouse's travel to the conference?
test.answer: Air travel claims need the e-ticket and boarding passes for every sector. [KB-04 §3] Hotel claims need an itemised hotel invoice showing the hotel's GSTIN. [KB-04 §3]
